what: Three photos stacked in one place — when the panel center passes down the 66% line of the screen the second photo appears, and when it passes the 33% line the third overlaps in over .3s, and scrolling back up reverses them. Not tied to scroll, it fires once at the moment of crossing a line — a spot where a small photo beside an intro text changes a couple of times while reading

options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or ‹0.25,0.1,0.25,1›, default power1.out (GSAP default)
options.at: Line positions (percent from top of screen, comma-separated) — number of photos minus 1. Default divides the screen by photo count (three → 66,33 · four → 75,50,25)
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photos to overlap (children) — all children if omitted. Needs two or more to run

note: In reduced motion, only the last slide is shown

from.where: index.html .hm-fac__fade (three 99:62 photos beside the facility intro — original customizeGsap: center 66% · center 33% gsap.to opacity .3s, onEnter · onLeaveBack)
